name: web/threejs-page
title: three.js page by hand
summary: Write one HTML file with a hand-written three.js page: CDN import map, renderer, scene, camera, light, objects, animation loop and resize handler.
when: Use when no kit fits and the page needs three.js written by hand: its own shapes, shaders or layout of objects.
steps: Write one index.html file for the page. The only thing it loads is the three.js CDN: no local scripts, styles or other files, and every script inline in the HTML with type="module" (a module file loaded from a local path does not load when the page is opened from disk).
Replace the box with the objects the page needs, each with its geometry, material and position. Keep the light: a MeshStandardMaterial is black without one.
Change something every frame inside the setAnimationLoop callback, such as a rotation or a position, and keep the renderer.render(scene, camera) call in it.
Keep the resize handler: it sets camera.aspect, calls camera.updateProjectionMatrix() and sets the renderer size to the window.
Call look_at_page on the index.html you wrote and fix every problem it reports; the page is done when it reports none.
next: Nothing more to do once look_at_page reports no problems: the page is finished. Do not rewrite it or add files; tell the user what the page shows.
